newsitem.title: CHINA: HK stocks seen rising in broad-based rally.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks seen rising in broad-based rally.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to put on an across-the-board rally on Monday following their positive performance before the weekend, but upside could be limited in the first few days of the week, brokers said.
"I think we are going up on the back of Wall Street and PPI numbers, but I think it will be limited," said a broker at Paribas Asia Equity.
The Hang Seng Index jumped 386.06 points, or 2.60 percent, to a record close of 15,225.29 on Friday, lifted by a turnaround in property shares.

The Dow industrials gained 35.06 points to 7,921.82 on Friday due to better-than-expected corporate earnings and a decline in the June Producer Price Index (PPI), the sixth consecutive monthly decline.
Range trading with upside at 15,500 points was the most likely short-term scenario, said the Paribas broker.

The property sector, which was a driver last week, would be a bit sluggish due to concerns about the outlook for the local real estate market, but would "be dragged better with the rest of the market", said James Osborn, in institutional sales at ING Barings.
